StudentProfile.title: StudentProfile
StudentProfile.description: Represents a student's personal learning profile, preferences, and key performance indicators.

id.description: Unique identifier for the StudentProfile entity.

name.description: The full name of the student.

classLevel.description: The current class or grade level of the student (e.g., '11th Grade').

selectedSubjectIds.description: References to the Subjects chosen by the student. (Relationship: StudentProfile N:N Subject)

currentScore.description: The student's latest overall score, typically from the most recent full diagnostic test or accumulated performance.

targetScore.description: The target score the student aims to achieve in the ҰБТ.

weakSubjectId.description: Reference to the Subject identified as the student's weakest. (Relationship: StudentProfile 1:N Subject)

strongSubjectId.description: Reference to the Subject identified as the student's strongest. (Relationship: StudentProfile 1:N Subject)

dailyAvailableStudyTimeMinutes.description: The daily amount of time, in minutes, the student has available for studying.

preferredLanguage.description: The student's preferred interface and content language (e.g., 'Kazakh').

preferredContentFormat.description: The student's preference for content format (e.g., 'short', 'detailed').

lastLoginAt.description: Timestamp of the student's last login.

registeredAt.description: Timestamp when the student registered on the platform.

Subject.title: Subject
Subject.description: Represents an academic subject available on the platform.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Subject entity.

description.description: A brief description of the subject.

iconUrl.description: URL to an icon representing the subject.

orderIndex.description: The display order of the subject in lists.

Topic.title: Topic
Topic.description: Represents a specific topic within a subject, forming the core unit of learning.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Topic entity.

subjectId.description: Reference to the parent Subject. (Relationship: Subject 1:N Topic)

name.description: The name of the topic (e.g., 'Тригонометрия', 'Алгебралық теңдеулер').

description.description: A brief description or summary of the topic.

difficulty.description: The perceived difficulty level of the topic (e.g., 'easy', 'medium', 'hard').

orderIndex.description: The display order of the topic within its subject.

TheoryContent.title: TheoryContent
TheoryContent.description: Contains the detailed theoretical learning material for a specific topic.

id.description: Unique identifier for the TheoryContent entity.

topicId.description: Reference to the Topic this theory content belongs to. (Relationship: Topic 1:N TheoryContent)

title.description: The title of the theory content section.

definition.description: The key definition related to the topic.

keyRule.description: The most important rule or principle for the topic.

formulaOrDateOrLaw.description: Important formulas, dates, or laws relevant to the topic, formatted as rich text.

explanation.description: A detailed explanation of the topic, formatted as rich text.

simpleExample.description: A simple example illustrating the concept, formatted as rich text.

ubtFormatAppearance.description: Description of how this topic typically appears or is tested in the ҰБТ.

commonMistakesText.description: A description of common mistakes students make related to this topic.

memoryHack.description: Tips or tricks to help remember the topic's concepts.

Question.title: Question
Question.description: Represents a single practice or test question for students.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Question entity.

topicId.description: Reference to the Topic this question belongs to. (Relationship: Topic 1:N Question)

questionText.description: The full text of the question.

options.description: An array of possible answer options for the question.

correctAnswerIndex.description: The 0-indexed position of the correct answer within the 'options' array.

difficulty.description: The difficulty level of the question (e.g., 'easy', 'medium', 'hard').

explanation.description: A detailed explanation for the correct answer.

incorrectExplanationTexts.description: Explanations for why each incorrect option is wrong, matching the order of 'options'.

commonMistakeWarning.description: A warning text advising students about common pitfalls for this question type.

relatedQuestionIds.description: References to other similar questions. (Relationship: Question N:N Question)

TestSession.title: TestSession
TestSession.description: Records a student's attempt at a test or quiz.

id.description: Unique identifier for the TestSession entity.

studentProfileId.description: Reference to the StudentProfile who took the test. (Relationship: StudentProfile 1:N TestSession)

subjectId.description: Reference to the Subject if the test is subject-specific. (Relationship: Subject 1:N TestSession)

topicId.description: Reference to the Topic if the test is topic-specific. (Relationship: Topic 1:N TestSession)

startedAt.description: Timestamp when the test session started.

completedAt.description: Timestamp when the test session was completed.

durationMinutes.description: The total duration of the test session in minutes.

totalQuestions.description: The total number of questions in the test.

correctAnswersCount.description: The number of questions answered correctly.

mistakesCount.description: The number of questions answered incorrectly.

scorePercentage.description: The percentage score achieved in the test.

accuracyPercentage.description: The percentage of questions answered correctly relative to total attempts.

averageTimePerQuestionSeconds.description: The average time spent per question in seconds.

TestAttemptDetail.title: TestAttemptDetail
TestAttemptDetail.description: Records the details of a student's answer for each question within a TestSession.

id.description: Unique identifier for the TestAttemptDetail entity.

testSessionId.description: Reference to the TestSession this attempt belongs to. (Relationship: TestSession 1:N TestAttemptDetail)

questionId.description: Reference to the Question attempted. (Relationship: Question 1:N TestAttemptDetail)

studentAnswerIndex.description: The 0-indexed position of the option chosen by the student.

isCorrect.description: Indicates whether the student's answer was correct.

timeTakenSeconds.description: The time, in seconds, the student took to answer this specific question.

MistakePattern.title: MistakePattern
MistakePattern.description: Identifies and describes common mistake patterns or frequently confused concepts.

id.description: Unique identifier for the MistakePattern entity.

title.description: A descriptive title for the mistake pattern (e.g., 'Arithmetic Progression vs Geometric Progression').

description.description: A detailed description of the mistake pattern and why it occurs.

concept1Reference.description: A textual or ID reference to the first concept involved in the confusion.

concept2Reference.description: A textual or ID reference to the second concept involved in the confusion.

reasonForConfusion.description: The underlying reason why these concepts are often confused.

warningText.description: A warning message or tip for students to avoid this specific mistake (e.g., 'Осы жерде абай бол').

relatedQuestionIds.description: References to Questions that are designed to test this specific mistake pattern. (Relationship: MistakePattern N:N Question)

StudyPlan.title: StudyPlan
StudyPlan.description: Represents a personalized study plan (daily or weekly) generated for a student.

id.description: Unique identifier for the StudyPlan entity.

studentProfileId.description: Reference to the StudentProfile this plan belongs to. (Relationship: StudentProfile 1:N StudyPlan)

startDate.description: The date when the study plan starts.

endDate.description: The date when the study plan ends.

status.description: The current status of the study plan (e.g., 'active', 'completed', 'archived').

targetScoreRange.description: The score range this plan is designed for (e.g., '50-70', '110+').

generatedAt.description: Timestamp when this study plan was generated.

lastUpdatedAt.description: Timestamp when this study plan was last updated (e.g., re-generated or status changed).

StudyPlanActivity.title: StudyPlanActivity
StudyPlanActivity.description: Represents an individual activity or task within a larger StudyPlan.

id.description: Unique identifier for the StudyPlanActivity entity.

studyPlanId.description: Reference to the parent StudyPlan. (Relationship: StudyPlan 1:N StudyPlanActivity)

subjectId.description: Reference to the Subject involved in this activity, if applicable. (Relationship: Subject 1:N StudyPlanActivity)

topicId.description: Reference to the Topic involved in this activity, if applicable. (Relationship: Topic 1:N StudyPlanActivity)

title.description: A descriptive title for the activity (e.g., '30 min theory on Algebra').

plannedDurationMinutes.description: The planned duration for this activity in minutes.

actualDurationMinutes.description: The actual time spent on this activity in minutes, if tracked.

targetCompletionDate.description: The target date for completing this activity.

isCompleted.description: Indicates whether the activity has been completed.

completedAt.description: Timestamp when the activity was marked as completed.

associatedEntityId.description: Reference to an associated entity (e.g., TheoryContent ID if 'theory_study', TestSession ID if 'test_practice').

ProgressRecord.title: ProgressRecord
ProgressRecord.description: Captures a snapshot of a student's progress and performance on a specific date.

id.description: Unique identifier for the ProgressRecord entity.

studentProfileId.description: Reference to the StudentProfile this record belongs to. (Relationship: StudentProfile 1:N ProgressRecord)

date.description: The date for which this progress record is captured.

totalLessonsCompletedToday.description: The total number of lessons or theory sections completed on this date.

totalQuestionsSolvedToday.description: The total number of practice or test questions solved on this date.

totalMistakesToday.description: The total number of incorrect answers on this date.

overallScore.description: The student's overall score at the end of this date.

overallAccuracyPercentage.description: The student's overall accuracy percentage at the end of this date.

studyTimeMinutesToday.description: The total time spent studying on this date in minutes.

hardestTopicIds.description: References to Topics identified as hardest for the student based on performance on this date. (Relationship: ProgressRecord N:N Topic)

easiestTopicIds.description: References to Topics identified as easiest for the student based on performance on this date. (Relationship: ProgressRecord N:N Topic)

CuratorMessage.title: CuratorMessage
CuratorMessage.description: Stores individual messages exchanged in the AI curator chat interface.

id.description: Unique identifier for the CuratorMessage entity.

studentProfileId.description: Reference to the StudentProfile involved in the conversation. (Relationship: StudentProfile 1:N CuratorMessage)

conversationId.description: Unique identifier for the entire chat conversation session, grouping related messages.

timestamp.description: Timestamp when the message was sent.

senderType.description: Indicates who sent the message ('student' or 'ai').

suggestedReplyOptions.description: An array of suggested reply texts presented to the user after this message.

motivationContentId.description: Optional reference to a MotivationContent entity if the AI response included a specific motivational card. (Relationship: MotivationContent 1:N CuratorMessage)

MotivationContent.title: MotivationContent
MotivationContent.description: Stores predefined motivational messages or content used by the AI curator.

id.description: Unique identifier for the MotivationContent entity.

title.description: A short title for the motivational content.

messageText.description: The full text of the motivational message or quote.

targetScoreRange.description: Optional: specifies a target score range for which this motivation is relevant (e.g., '50-70').

tags.description: An array of tags for categorizing motivation content (e.g., 'positive', 'actionable', 'calm').

A collection used to define administrative roles. A document's existence in this collection, where the document ID (`uid`) matches `request.auth.uid`, grants administrative privileges. This follows the Database-backed Access Control (DBAC) pattern.

firestore.reasoning:
The recommended Firestore structure is designed to be secure, scalable, and debuggable by strictly adhering to the core design principles. The primary strategy employed is **Authorization Independence via Denormalization** (Mandate A) by embedding the `studentProfileId` (which corresponds to `request.auth.uid`) directly into the paths of all user-specific data collections. For instance, `TestSession` documents are stored under `/studentProfiles/{studentProfileId}/testSessions/{testSessionId}`. This eliminates the need for `get()` calls in security rules to check ownership of parent documents, simplifying rule logic and making operations like atomic creation of related documents (`TestSession` and `TestAttemptDetail`) more robust. All documents in a given subcollection inherit the authorization context from the path, ensuring that `request.auth.uid` can be directly compared with the `{studentProfileId}` wildcard in rules for read/write access.

**Structural Segregation** (Mandate B) is applied by categorizing data into two main groups: globally accessible content and user-specific private data. Global content, such as `Subjects`, `Topics`, `TheoryContent`, `Questions`, `MistakePatterns`, and `MotivationContent`, is stored at the root level or nested under other global collections (e.g., `/subjects/{subjectId}/topics/{topicId}`). These collections will have read-all access for authenticated students, and restricted write access for administrators. User-specific data, including `StudentProfile`, `TestSession`, `StudyPlan`, `ProgressRecord`, and `CuratorMessage`, is strictly organized under `/studentProfiles/{studentProfileId}/...` paths, ensuring private ownership.

This segregation and path-based ownership directly supports **Query Against Path (QAPs)** (Principle 4). For global content, listing all subjects or questions is inherently secure as they are public/admin-managed. For user-specific data, `list` operations are automatically scoped by the path, meaning a student can only `list` their own `TestSessions` or `StudyPlans` because the query path itself must include their authenticated UID, preventing unauthorized data enumeration. For example, a query to `/studentProfiles/{request.auth.uid}/testSessions` is secure by design. Admin roles are managed via a dedicated `/roles_admin/{uid}` collection following **DBAC** (Principle 3) and **Existence over Content** (Mandate C.4).

The structure promotes **Clarity of Intent** (Principle 2) by making access patterns explicit. For instance, `/studentProfiles/{studentProfileId}` clearly indicates a profile belonging to `studentProfileId`, while `/subjects/{subjectId}/topics/{topicId}` is unequivocally public educational content. Consistent naming (`studentProfileId`, `subjectId`, `topicId`) and descriptive wildcards contribute to **Data Clarity and Predictability** (Mandate D), making security rules easier to write, understand, and debug.
